title: ModbusMappingConfig
description: Configuration schema for the Modbus adapter mapping. Describes how Modbus function requests are normalized into BASIS authorization requests.

routes.description: Ordered list of route mappings. Routes are evaluated in order; the first match wins.

ModbusRouteMapping.description: Maps a Modbus function and register type to normalized authorization semantics.

name.description: Optional human-readable route name. Must be unique across all routes in the config if non-empty.

function.description: Modbus function code name to match. Use '*' to match any function.

register_type.description: Register type to match, e.g. 'holding_register', 'coil', 'input_register', 'discrete_input'. Use '*' to match any register type.

action.description: Normalized action verb. If empty, the default function→action map is used (reads→read, writes→write).

resource_id_template.description: Template for the resource ID. May reference {function}, {unit_id}, {address}, {quantity}, {register_type} using {param} syntax.
